records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Just wanted to say hi and see how things are going with Wrenfield so far. Reply whenever, no rush.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Lantern Partners!
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Great to have you. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, but if you'd rather skip ahead, the important part is just getting real work into it rather than a placeholder.

Reply here with any questions.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero product progress (no project, no invite, no milestone) and no reply to three Wrenfield emails (email:7eb1b426, email:16cd42af, email:14c1f0d6), plus no tickets, signals disengagement. Only 8 days left, so unaided activation is unlikely though not impossible.

draft.subject: Getting your first project set up in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

I know I've reached out a couple of times already, so I'll keep this brief. You're on Pro and the workspace is ready, but it looks like there isn't a first project in it yet. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so that's the one step that makes everything else click.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through getting a real piece of your work into a project with you, or answer anything over email if that's easier.

Best,
Chidi
